key_insight: OnTrack streams over agent trajectories in real time to detect divergence from successful behavior early enough to alert or stop unsafe or wasteful runs.
engineering_relevance: This enables low-latency safeguards for LLM agents in production, reducing cost and risk without adding a full second monitor at every step.
method: Compares each incoming step and its dependencies against reference successful trajectories using streaming, structure-aware optimal transport.
Supports three access levels: full history + tool schemas, tool schemas only, or only generated logs.
Flags plan violations, loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls, with decisions made in about a millisecond per step.
evidence_signal: On SWE-bench trajectories, using the first 8 steps improved failure-vs-success ranking by +0.057 AUROC over content similarity, and an abort policy saved about 18% compute with 5 of 6 aborts correct.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and availability of reference trajectories or schemas, so weaker access can reduce detection power and increase false alarms.
paper_title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
